name: Human decision rights: what AI may do versus what needs human approval
description: AI proposes, evidence supports, the Data Steward evaluates, the appropriate human owner approves. HANDOFF lists what AI may do and what needs human approval.

name: Data Steward role and scope
description: The target role is a data governance role rather than an operational incident-resolution role.

repo_locations.anchor: data governance role rather than an operational incident-resolution role

name: Data Owner and ownership assignment, including ownership gaps
description: Ownership assignment needs human approval; the Definition & CDE agent surfaces ownership gaps.

name: Governance bodies, escalation path and the named human governance owner
description: Escalations route to a named human governance owner who is not yet named (defaults to the project owner); Phase 0b requires roles to be named.

name: Governance policy, standards and policy interpretation
description: Policy interpretation where material needs human approval; agents must not present inferred policy as fact.

name: Governance reporting and metrics
description: Governance reporting is in scope for the steward; the success criteria define what the system must demonstrate.

name: Continuous improvement of stewardship practice
description: Continuous improvement is a listed stewardship responsibility.

name: Stakeholder input: SMEs, Data Owners and operations teams
description: Agents identify unresolved questions that need SME or Data Owner input.

name: Business definitions and their approval lifecycle
description: Agents draft candidate definitions; approving a business definition is a human decision.

name: Business glossary: terms, synonyms and terminology conflicts
description: Locate and compare existing definitions; identify synonyms, conflicts and missing definitions.

name: Data dictionary, technical metadata and documentation
description: Data dictionaries and documentation are listed stewardship responsibilities.

name: Critical data elements: criteria, designation and evidence
description: CDE designation is a human decision; the agent gathers CDE evidence; no CDE-criteria policy document is named yet.

name: Metadata management: repository, ownership and Stewardship as Code
description: Governance artefacts held as versioned, machine-readable metadata where that improves traceability.

name: Provenance and evidence trail for claims
description: Every material claim separates authoritative internal evidence, general industry context, agent inference, open questions and human decisions.

name: Data lineage and downstream impact
description: Lineage completeness and downstream impact are examined by the Mapping & Lineage agent.

name: Source-to-target mappings and transformation semantics
description: The key question is whether the meaning survived the transformation.

repo_locations.anchor: Did the meaning survive the transformation

name: Data contracts and upstream dependency management
description: Data contracts and upstream dependency management are listed stewardship responsibilities.

name: Data quality dimensions (the taxonomy)
description: No approved Data-Quality-Dimension taxonomy exists yet (Open Question 5; Phase 0b item 2).

name: Quality rules, expectations and candidate controls and tests
description: Translate approved business expectations into candidate rules, tests and controls.

name: Quality thresholds and acceptance of data-quality risk
description: Quality thresholds and acceptance of data-quality risk are human decisions.

name: Quality measurement, monitoring and control coverage
description: Control coverage analysis is a future capability in the backlog.

name: Quality issue and exception management
description: Cluster quality exceptions, recognise recurring characteristics, and route them for human decision.

name: Root-cause analysis and recurring quality patterns
description: Root-cause hypotheses must be evidence-backed; the final root cause is a human decision where evidence is incomplete.

name: Fitness for purpose
description: Data quality is judged as fitness-for-purpose.

name: Reference and master data stewardship
description: The Context agent covers domain content such as transactions, positions, valuation, NAV and reconciliation; no reference or master data stewardship artefact exists.

name: Authoritative sources and systems of record
description: Internal documented position outranks general knowledge; authoritative sources are named per agent.

name: Data architecture knowledge: source platforms and data flows
description: Relevant source platforms and enterprise data products are part of the Context agent's content areas.

name: Data classification, confidentiality and permitted use, including AI processing
description: No production connectivity or confidential data in the repo; the organisation's data-handling policy is an open question.

name: Ethical handling of data and transparency
description: Systems must not hide uncertainty or present inferred organisational policy as fact.

name: Regulatory and audit traceability
description: Regulatory reporting is a domain topic and every material conclusion must be traceable to evidence.

name: Stewardship operating model and organisation structure
description: A single Data Steward supported by a Factory layer and an operational agent team; no business-versus-technical steward structure is defined.

name: Capability measurement and success criteria
description: Success criteria define a governed, traceable stewardship capability; no maturity measure is defined.
